login.title: Admin sign in
login.subtitle: Platform administrators only. Every action is audited.
login.heroTitle: Manage every FlowZa Time tenant from one place.
login.heroBody: Tenants, subscriptions, members, support access and platform health — with multi-factor authentication on every session.
login.notAdmin: This sign-in is for platform administrators only.
login.tenantLogin: Not an administrator? Go to the FlowZa Time sign-in

gate.notAdminHint: {{email}} has no platform administrator access. Sign in with an administrator account.

tempPassword.banner: You are signed in with a temporary password. Change it now.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: The whole FlowZa Time fleet at a glance.
dashboard.trialsSoon: Trials ending in the next 14 days
dashboard.trialsSoonEmpty: No trial ends in the next 14 days.

tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.subtitle: Every organisation on the platform. Open one to edit its details, subscription and account.

tenant.editHint: Changes are audited on the organisation and visible to its owners.

account.title: Account management
account.hint: Platform-only: the tenant never sees these fields.
account.tagsPlaceholder: Add a tag and press Enter
account.tagsHint: Up to 20 tags, e.g. enterprise, pilot, partner.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.noneHint: This tenant has no subscription yet. Choose a plan to create one.
subscription.editHint: Plan and status changes take effect immediately and are audited with your reason.
subscription.reasonHint: At least 3 characters, e.g. "Signed the annual contract".
subscription.extendReason: Trial extended by {{count}} days from the admin portal
subscription.seatsHint: Licensed employees the tenant pays for (caps employee creation). Empty = the plan's employee limit.

members.title: Members
members.hint: Everyone with access to this tenant. Directory data only — no employee or attendance records.

notes.title: Internal notes
notes.hint: Visible to platform administrators only. Notes cannot be edited — add a correcting note instead.
notes.placeholder: Write a note — a call, an agreement, a follow-up…

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: Every action a platform administrator took, across all tenants.
activity.tenantHint: What platform administrators changed on this tenant.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Every FlowZa Time account and the tenants it belongs to.
users.name: Name
users.noMemberships: This account belongs to no tenant.

team.title: Admin team
team.subtitle: Who can sign in to this portal. Only owners can add administrators or change levels.
team.addHint: The person must already have a FlowZa Time account (they signed up or accepted an invitation once). They will be asked to set up MFA at their first admin sign-in.
team.levelHint: Support and Admin manage tenants; Owners also manage this team.
team.ownerOnly: Only a platform owner can change the team.
team.selfLocked: You cannot change your own access.
team.disableHint: They lose access to the admin portal immediately. You can enable them again later.

grantsPage.title: Access grants
grantsPage.subtitle: Time-boxed support access of platform administrators to tenant data. Write access needs a second approver.

plansPage.title: Plans & pricing
plansPage.subtitle: The plans tenants subscribe to: price per cycle, users included, modules and limits.

flagsPage.title: Feature flags
flagsPage.subtitle: Platform defaults. Tenants can be overridden individually on their Feature flags tab.

healthPage.title: System health
healthPage.subtitle: Job queue and platform counters, refreshed every 15 seconds.

account.title: My account
account.subtitle: Your administrator profile and sign-in security.
account.mfaOn: Enabled — required for every admin session
account.passwordHint: At least 12 characters with upper- and lower-case letters, a digit and a symbol.
account.tooWeak: Use at least 12 characters with upper- and lower-case letters, a digit and a symbol.
account.tempHint: You are using the temporary password this account was created with.

reason.label: Reason
reason.hint: At least 3 characters. The tenant sees it in its audit log.

modules.title: Modules
modules.subtitle: Switch product modules on and off — fleet-wide or for every tenant at once. Per-tenant switches are on each tenant's Modules tab.
modules.rule: A module is on for a tenant when it is available fleet-wide, the subscription has not lapsed, and the tenant's own switch — or, without one, its plan — includes it.
modules.core: Employees, attendance and corrections, shifts and holidays, reports, approvals, users, settings and audit are the core of FlowZa Time and are always on. Switching a module off never deletes data and never stops terminals from recording punches.
modules.resetAll: Every tenant back to its plan

makeAvailable.title: Make {{name}} available
makeAvailable.body: Tenants whose plan or switch includes {{name}} get it back immediately.

makeUnavailable.title: Turn {{name}} off fleet-wide
makeUnavailable.body: {{name}} closes for every tenant at once, whatever their plan or switch says. Their data is kept.

enable.title: Turn {{name}} on for every tenant
enable.body: Records an override for each of the {{count}} tenants, whatever their plan says.

disable.title: Turn {{name}} off for every tenant
disable.body: Records an override for each of the {{count}} tenants. Their data is kept.

reset.title: Every tenant back to its plan for {{name}}
reset.body: Removes the per-tenant switches of {{name}}: each tenant gets what its plan includes.

tenantModules.title: Modules
tenantModules.hint: What this tenant can use. A switch records an override of the plan, with your reason; the tenant sees it in its audit log.
tenantModules.lapsed: The subscription is expired or cancelled: only the core is available until it is renewed.
tenantModules.enableBody: The tenant gets this module now, even if its plan does not include it.
tenantModules.disableBody: The module's pages and API close for this tenant now. Nothing is deleted; turning it back on restores everything.
tenantModules.resetBody: The switch is removed and the plan decides again (the module will be: {{state}}).

plans.editorHint: Prices exclude VAT. A plan's base price includes its users; every user beyond that is charged the extra-user price.
plans.keyFixed: The key cannot change once tenants may use it.
plans.keyHint: Lower-case letters, digits and _, e.g. professional.
plans.trialHint: Days of trial a new tenant on this plan gets (0 = the default 14).
plans.includedHint: Users covered by the base price.
plans.preview: Yearly for the included users: {{amount}} for {{users}} users (≈ {{perUser}} per user per month).
plans.noPrice: No price: free or custom plan.
plans.modulesHint: What tenants on this plan can use. The core of the product is always included.
plans.limitsHint: Empty = no limit. A tenant's paid users replace the employee limit.
plans.calculatorHint: What a tenant pays for a plan, cycle and number of users — the same arithmetic as the invoices.
plans.noPricedPlans: No active plan has a price yet.

billing.title: Subscriptions & billing
billing.subtitle: Revenue, invoices and payments across every tenant. Prices exclude VAT; invoices add it.

kpi.mrrHint: Active and past-due subscriptions, yearly ones spread per month
kpi.unpricedHint: Active subscriptions whose plan has no price

billing.subscriptionsHint: Every tenant's plan, cycle, paid users and price.
billing.newInvoiceHint: A plan priced for a cycle and a number of users, and / or custom lines. VAT is added on the discounted subtotal.
billing.periodHint: Empty = today. The period runs one cycle.
billing.noPlanPrice: {{name}} has no price: add the invoice lines below.
billing.subscriptionActivated: Subscription activated for the invoiced plan and period
billing.appliedOn: Subscription updated from this invoice on {{date}}.
billing.willActivate: When fully paid, the tenant's subscription moves to this plan, cycle, users and period.
billing.voidBody: A void invoice stays on record and takes no payment. Refund any payment first.
billing.tenantInvoicesHint: What FlowZa invoiced this tenant. The tenant's owner sees these under Settings → Subscription.

settings.title: Platform settings
settings.subtitle: The product's name and support contact, and how invoices are issued.
settings.generalHint: Shown to tenants on their subscription page and on invoices.
settings.billingHint: Used for every new invoice (issued invoices keep what they were issued with).
settings.currencyHint: ISO code, e.g. OMR. Plans are priced in this currency.
